remarks: For a video tour, You Tube the property address. Discover the rare opportunity to own a single-family home in the heart of Greenwich Avenue. Unlike your typical options of apartments or condominiums, this residence provides independent living, free from association fees, shared walls, and issues commonly associated with condos. This home boasts high-quality finish materials and a custom kitchen featuring a professional gas range. Built in 2014, experience modern elegance, hardwood floors throughout, 4 full bathrooms, and 4 bedrooms, including a convenient 1st floor bedroom, 3 of the bedrooms are ensuite. Plus mudroom and private patio. Moreover, the location is truly central, offering private off-street parking and easy access to everything Greenwich Ave has to offer, including nearly 200 shops, top-rated restaurants, and diverse shopping experiences. Commuting is a breeze with a 12-minute walk or 3-minute drive to the Greenwich train station, which connects you to Grand Central Station in approximately 45 minutes. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the excellent location for walks, runs, or bike rides, as well as quick access to I-95, Bruce Park's trails and amenities, and picturesque views along Steamboat Road. Grocery shopping at Whole Foods is just a 4-minute drive away. This unique home offers a harmonious blend of luxury, convenience, and a coveted location in one of Connecticut's premier shopping destinations, making it an opportunity you won't want to miss
